newsitem.title: FRANCE: INTERVIEW - Volvo to continue to seek cooperations.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Volvo to continue to seek cooperations.

text.p: Swedish carmaker Volvo has the partners and cooperations it needs but it will continue to seek new cooperations if that will benefit its business, CEO Soren Gyll told Reuters in an interview on Tuesday.

"Right now we have all the cooperations we need, but we will take the opportunity to go into new ones if that can benefit our business. But I want to stress, that nothing is in the making now," Gyll said.
He stressed that Volvo already has declared its willingness to cooperate with outside partners in certain areas and that it is a natural process to do so.
"When you cooperate with another company it is a win-win situation. You gain from it, as well as your partner. That comes from investing in each other," Gyll said.
